title: Apply Blocks theme to the dashboard, responsive layout
outcome: The dashboard page is restyled using m3-001's ported Panel/Card components, grouping accounts by institution, and is comfortably usable at phone-sized viewport widths. All m1/m2 functional behavior (data, error states) is unchanged.
acceptance: app/page.tsx (or wherever the dashboard renders) uses the ported Panel and/or Card components instead of m1's plain-CSS markup to display accounts grouped by institution.
The page renders correctly and legibly at a phone-sized viewport (e.g. 375px wide) -- no horizontal scrolling, no overlapping or clipped text, balances and institution names remain readable.

All existing behavior from m1/m2 is preserved exactly: the same data source (the shared SimpleFin module), the same missing-env-var error state, the same upstream-failure error state -- restyled, not reimplemented.
No changes to lib/simplefin.ts, the MCP route, or any auth logic in this task -- presentation only.
Existing tests from m1/m2 continue to pass (update any DOM-structure-dependent test assertions to match the new markup, but do not weaken what they assert about behavior).
The repository's required verification command (./scripts/verify-task.sh) passes.

Manual verification: with SIMPLEFIN_ACCESS_URL pointed at SimpleFin's public demo bridge, pnpm run dev and loading the page at both a desktop and a phone-sized viewport shows the demo accounts grouped by institution, styled with the Blocks theme -- record this manual check's result in the task's completion report.
